This '''red-bladed''' '''lightsaber''' was the [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith weapon]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]], [[Galen Marek]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] codenamed '''Starkiller'''. The apprentice's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was of a skeletal and utilitarian design. Intended for both [[Sith training|training]] and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]] purposes, it served multiple purposes such as the many sparring matches between the apprentice and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Holodroid/Legends|holodroid]] [[PROXY]], as well as [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] sessions in which he concentrated on [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] re-assembling his lightsaber for modifications.

As his training neared completion by [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the apprentice was dispatched on a series of tasks to assassinate three fugitive [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]]&mdash;[[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], [[Kazdan Paratus]] and [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]. Upon the completion of his final trials, Vader [[Shiak|betrayed]] his apprentice on the orders of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and cast him out into space. As a result, Marek's lightsaber was lost in the vacuum of space, though he was ultimately saved from [[Death/Legends|death]] by his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] in order to be redeployed on several new missions that would lead to the [[Corellian Treaty|formation]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Due to the loss of his apprentice's lightsaber, Darth Vader provided Marek with [[Rahm Kota's lightsaber|another lightsaber]] as a replacement.

==Specifications==
Galen Marek's first lightsaber appeared to be based on the [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|design]] utilized by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], featuring an [[Blade emitter/Legends|emitter shroud]] and a mostly solid casing. However, rather than follow the over-sized, bulky design of his master's [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|weapon]],<ref name="Dark Lord" /> Marek opted for a considerably more skeletal make. His weapon featured an exposed [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] chamber, and rather than include a handgrip, the whole of the weapon was sheathed in somewhat tarnished looking bare-metal.<ref name="TFUvg" /> The blade utilized a set of [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|red crystals]] supplied by Vader.<ref name="TFUn" />

==History==
[[File:Marek_saber_construction.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Galen Marek using telekinesis to reassemble his lightsaber.]]
Like much of Galen Marek's [[Sith training|training]], the circumstances of the lightsabers creation were brutal. As a child, Marek once ordered PROXY to chain him up and not give him food or water until he could take apart and rebuild the lightsaber using only the Force. He did not succeed, and PROXY was forced to release him from his bonds.<ref name="TFUn" /> While this early effort was a failure, Marek did eventually succeed in crafting a lightsaber, and it saw frequent use in training duels with his droid, [[PROXY]], and even with Vader himself. One such match lasted for hours, with Vader simply holding off Marek until the apprentice collapsed from exhaustion. At one point, Marek was sent on a mission to [[Yuzzem]] homeworld [[Ragna III]], where he discovered that Vader had sabotaged the lightsaber, forcing Marek to fight off the Yuzzem with his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]].<ref name="TFU2n">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref>

Marek wielded the lightsaber against a Jedi for the first time when he was sent to eliminate [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], who was [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|attacking an Imperial shipyard]] above [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Carving his way through the facility, killing Imperials and [[Kota's Militia|Kota's men]] alike, as per Vader's orders to leave no witnesses, Marek finally engaged Kota within the command center of the shipyard. After a heated duel, Marek bested Kota by blinding him with [[Rahm Kota's lightsaber|his own blade]], pushing it into his face during a blade-lock. The lightsaber would subsequently see use against [[Kazdan Paratus]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], though Marek would be forced to best Paratus with his Force abilities, due to Paratus' lightsaber skills.<ref name="TFUvg" /><ref name="TFUn" />

[[File:Starkiller_vs_Felucians.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Galen Marek wielding his lightsaber on Felucia.]]
On his way to reporting back to Vader, Marek telekinetically dismantled and reassembled his lightsaber while in meditation, though he was interrupted by a communication from Vader, breaking his concentration and scattering the lightsaber components across the floor of [[Rogue Shadow|his ship's]] onboard training room. Marek was ordered to travel to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and eliminate [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], one of the last surviving members of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="TFUvg" /> Confronting Ti, Marek only narrowly managed to defeat her, impaling her with his own blade while only barely blocking her attack with telekinesis. Returning to Vader to report his success, Marek was betrayed, his existence having been found out by Emperor Palpatine. On Palpatine's orders, Marek was thrown into the vacuum of space, and lost the lightsaber to the void.<ref name="TFUn" />

Galen Marek's near dead body was quickly retrieved, and after a recovery period, he resumed his service to Vader, wielding Kota's [[Rahm Kota's lightsaber|lightsaber]] as a replacement for his original weapon.<ref name="TFUn" />

==Behind the scenes==
The loss of Galen Marek's lightsaber is a plot element exclusive to the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|novelization]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'', with the various game versions and the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|graphic novel adaptation]] depicting Marek continuing to use his original lightsaber, albeit with a blue blade. Likewise, versions of the game allowed Marek to replace the hilt and crystals with others that could be collected by the player. However, due to the inconsistencies between the various game versions of the story on numerous plot points, the novelization is generally accepted as the final word, so the loss of Marek's lightsaber is considered part of Legends canon.

In the non-canon dark side alternate ending, Marek slays Darth Vader, but is [[Battle on Death Star I|defeated]] by Darth Sidious on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] and reconstructed as a cyborg to serve as his apprentice. In the ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Ultimate Sith Edition|Ultimate Sith Edition]]'' DLC, [[Sith Warrior (Galen Marek)|Lord Starkiller]] can be seen with his old lightsaber on his belt, along with the lightsabers of Darth Vader, Rahm Kota, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], and the top portion of [[Kazdan Paratus's lightsaber pike|Kazdan Paratus's]] [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]]. By this point, the Sith Lord has taken to using a new lightsaber.
